name: Writhing Rot
look: a hollow rotting log on gnarled root legs with Sudowoodo's orange zigzags, a long white segmented grub neck writhing out of the hollow to a skull-like head with glowing yellow eyes and orange mandibles, white feelers and a segmented tail
entry: An ancient Pokémon said to be the distant past of Sudowoodo, described in an old expedition journal. Its log body is only a shell: the real Pokémon is the pale, writhing thing that lives inside it, and it lunges out on a long neck to snatch prey.
how: Wild: very rare in old-growth forests and taigas, dark forests and jungles.
